Underwater#000.src: I will need those [{~} Gudgeon Meat] from the cave if you want that helmet!
Underwater#000.dst: Il me faut ces [{~} Gudgeon Meat] de la grotte si tu veux ce casque!

similar.text: I'm glad to see you again.

Underwater#002.src: But recently, a small hole has opened in the shipwreck here. It is believed that our fortune is hidden within it.
Underwater#002.dst: Mais récemment, un petit trou s'est ouvert dans l'épave. On pense que notre fortune y est cachée.
Underwater#002.speaker: Omango

Underwater#003.src: Talk to Omango located at the North of {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Underwater#003.dst: Parlez à Omango, au nord de {p}, en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Underwater#004.src: Hi, my name is Omango. I am a resident of the {p} village, on top of the hill.
Underwater#004.dst: Salut, je m'appelle Omango. J'habite au village de {p}, en haut de la colline.
Underwater#004.speaker: Omango

Underwater#005.src: As you may know, our people came to your land years ago, and this is the ship they used.
Underwater#005.dst: Comme tu le sais peut-être, mon peuple est venu sur tes terres il y a des années, sur ce navire.
Underwater#005.speaker: Omango

Underwater#006.src: They brought lots of luxurious goods with them. Most of them got lost in the wreck.
Underwater#006.dst: Ils ont apporté beaucoup de produits de luxe. La plupart ont été perdus dans le naufrage.
Underwater#006.speaker: Omango

Underwater#007.src: Unfortunately, nobody has been able to explore it. It is too deep, no creature can survive underwater that long!
Underwater#007.dst: Malheureusement, personne n'a pu l'explorer. C'est trop profond, aucune créature ne survit aussi longtemps sous l'eau!
Underwater#007.speaker: Omango

Underwater#008.src: However, my old friend Sayrr is a fisherman, and I know that he has a very special helmet...
Underwater#008.dst: Mais mon vieil ami Sayrr est pêcheur, et je sais qu'il a un casque très spécial...
Underwater#008.speaker: Omango

Underwater#009.src: If you convince him to give you this helmet, and find the treasure, I'll give you a part of it!
Underwater#009.dst: Si tu le convaincs de te donner ce casque et que tu trouves le trésor, je t'en donnerai une part!
Underwater#009.speaker: Omango

Underwater#010.src: Sayrr is out on his boat, but the cave next to me is a quick way over to where he does his fishing. Be careful on the way, though.
Underwater#010.dst: Sayrr est sur son bateau, mais la grotte à côté de moi est un raccourci vers son coin de pêche. Fais quand même attention en chemin.
Underwater#010.speaker: Omango

Underwater#011.src: When you finally have the helmet, explore the ship and bring me back [{~} Ancient Treasure]. Good luck.
Underwater#011.dst: Quand tu auras enfin le casque, explore le navire et rapporte-moi [{~} Ancient Treasure]. Bonne chance.
Underwater#011.speaker: Omango

Underwater#012.src: Go through the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to find Sayrr on his boat on the other side
Underwater#012.dst: Traversez la grotte en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] pour trouver Sayrr sur son bateau, de l'autre côté

Underwater#013.src: Why ya looking at me like that? Is it cause I'm small, eh? I'll have you know that I caught fish that were twice your size!
Underwater#013.dst: Pourquoi tu me regardes comme ça? C'est parce que je suis petit, hein? Sache que j'ai pêché des poissons deux fois plus gros que toi!
Underwater#013.speaker: Sayrr

Underwater#014.src: ...or, well, I used to be able to. Nothing's biting recently- wait a sec, why'd you hop on my boat anyways, stranger?
Underwater#014.dst: ...enfin, avant, j'y arrivais. Rien ne mord ces temps-ci- attends une seconde, pourquoi t'es monté sur mon bateau, d'abord, l'étranger?
Underwater#014.speaker: Sayrr

Underwater#015.src: Ahah! Yes, I still have that old breathing helmet. You want it? You'll have to do something for me first.
Underwater#015.dst: Ahah! Oui, j'ai encore ce vieux casque respiratoire. Tu le veux? Faudra d'abord faire un truc pour moi.
Underwater#015.speaker: Sayrr

Underwater#016.src: I'm sure you heard me, but the fish just aren't biting around here anymore! I need to make a living somehow! There's some fish in that cave, but...
Underwater#016.dst: Tu m'as sûrement entendu, mais les poissons ne mordent plus du tout par ici! Faut bien que je gagne ma vie! Y a des poissons dans cette grotte, mais...
Underwater#016.speaker: Sayrr

Underwater#017.src: ...it's a bit dangerous. Tell ya what, I'll give you my fishing rod, and you can go catch me, say, [{~} Gudgeon Meat] down there.
Underwater#017.dst: ...c'est un peu dangereux. Écoute, je te file ma canne à pêche, et tu vas m'attraper, disons, [{~} Gudgeon Meat] là-dessous.
Underwater#017.speaker: Sayrr

Underwater#018.src: The helmet will be all yours after that.
Underwater#018.dst: Le casque sera à toi après ça.
Underwater#018.speaker: Sayrr

Underwater#019.src: Bring back [{~} Gudgeon Meat] found in the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to Sayrr
Underwater#019.dst: Rapportez à Sayrr [{~} Gudgeon Meat] trouvé dans la grotte en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Underwater#020.src: Ah! Welcome back! Any luck with the fish?
Underwater#020.dst: Ah! Te revoilà! T'as eu de la chance avec les poissons?
Underwater#020.speaker: Sayrr

Underwater#021.src: Great, and I'll thank you kindly. Here's your helmet, have fun with that.
Underwater#021.dst: Génial, je t'en remercie bien. Voilà ton casque, amuse-toi bien avec.
Underwater#021.speaker: Sayrr

Underwater#022.src: Explore the crashed ship for a lost treasure at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Underwater#022.dst: Explorez l'épave du navire à la recherche d'un trésor perdu en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Underwater#023.src: Break the crate and bring [{~} Old Treasure] to Omango at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Underwater#023.dst: Cassez la caisse et apportez [{~} Old Treasure] à Omango en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Underwater#024.src: You got it! You found the treasure!
Underwater#024.dst: Tu l'as! Tu as trouvé le trésor!
Underwater#024.speaker: Omango

Underwater#025.src: As promised, here's your part of the loot.
Underwater#025.dst: Comme promis, voici ta part du butin.
Underwater#025.speaker: Omango

Underwater#026.src: You have lost the helmet already?
Underwater#026.speaker: Sayrr

Underwater#027.src: Let me help you then! Bring me back [{~} Gudgeon Meat] from the cave just like last time and i will give you one back! Deal?
Underwater#027.dst: Alors laisse-moi t'aider! Rapporte-moi [{~} Gudgeon Meat] de la grotte comme la dernière fois et je t'en redonne un! Marché conclu?
Underwater#027.speaker: Sayrr

Underwater#028.src: You should go see Omango back near the crashed ship!
Underwater#028.dst: Tu devrais aller voir Omango, près de l'épave!
Underwater#028.speaker: Sayrr

Underwater#029.src: This must be the treasure Omango was talking about!
Underwater#029.dst: Ce doit être le trésor dont parlait Omango!
